contents: Displayed yield, actual good yield, and shop-floor defects did not agree, so measurement and decision reliability had to be checked before process settings. I led assembly-process trials and cross-team coordination, narrowing causes from measurement and sensors through inspection, jigs, consumables, and finally recipes. The team recorded 98.7% monthly average good yield in December 2024, and I directly revised the MSA criteria, SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, and inspection standards.
summary: Displayed yield, actual good yield, and shop-floor defects did not agree, so measurement and decision reliability had to be checked before process settings. The team recorded 98.7% monthly average good yield in December 2024, and I directly revised the MSA criteria, SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, and inspection standards.
title: 2170 Assembly-Line Yield Stabilization

contents: Development and handover were complete, but automatic cycles and vision inspection did not run normally, operators moved each unit manually, and MES history was not recorded correctly. I set assembly-wide trial and decision criteria, coordinated technology, maintenance, and production actions, and revised measurement methods and control documents. After recovery trials covering about 200 cells in two lots over roughly two weeks, the final 50-cell one-way run achieved FYD of at least 90%, which was used as the limited-production start gate.
summary: Development and handover were complete, but automatic cycles and vision inspection did not run normally, operators moved each unit manually, and MES history was not recorded correctly. After recovery trials covering about 200 cells in two lots over roughly two weeks, the final 50-cell one-way run achieved FYD of at least 90%, which was used as the limited-production start gate.
title: 4695 Production Transition Validation

contents: Material and structure changes in the LFP power cell made existing 2170 assembly and inspection settings unsuitable. Working with development, I separated change effects by process and owned assembly-wide sample building, inspection, condition decisions, and control-document revisions. The team advanced through internal A, B, and C samples, about 20,000-cell initial trial production, customer qualification, and CCB P.O approval. Commercial production did not proceed because of pricing.
summary: Material and structure changes in the LFP power cell made existing 2170 assembly and inspection settings unsuitable. The team advanced through internal A, B, and C samples, about 20,000-cell initial trial production, customer qualification, and CCB P.O approval. title: 25P LFP Cell Development and Trial Production

contents: A collector-based Tabless structure differed from the lead-tab process and could not be repeated without dedicated jigs and inspection methods. I built temporary jigs for 4695 equipment and handled process conditions, manual assembly, welding, inspection, and performance evaluation. After about 100 exploratory builds, five samples were suitable for functional checks; a limited same-material, same-cycle comparison indicated lower IR and improved life direction.
summary: A collector-based Tabless structure differed from the lead-tab process and could not be repeated without dedicated jigs and inspection methods. After about 100 exploratory builds, five samples were suitable for functional checks; a limited same-material, same-cycle comparison indicated lower IR and improved life direction.
title: 2170 Tabless A-Sample Build Validation

contents: Limited FAT samples and individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, repeatability, or readiness for actual production. I built acceptance sheets and punch lists, tracked supplier corrections and retests, and led actual cell production plus measurement and process-standard work. Initial assembly yield was about 95% across roughly 1,000 cells over five days, including reworked cells that met quality criteria.
summary: Limited FAT samples and individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, repeatability, or readiness for actual production. Initial assembly yield was about 95% across roughly 1,000 cells over five days, including reworked cells that met quality criteria.
title: NCM Prismatic Pilot-Line Acceptance and Stabilization

contents: The incumbent supplier could not cover the planned follow-on volume alone, so a new can supplier required manufacturing and quality validation. I translated material-property and bottom-geometry differences into beading, crimping, and sealing risks, then set the assembly conditions and validation sequence. After 600 cells across three lots and an official UN38.3 pass, purchasing and subsequent pilot production moved to the alternative can after existing stock was consumed.
summary: The incumbent supplier could not cover the planned follow-on volume alone, so a new can supplier required manufacturing and quality validation. After 600 cells across three lots and an official UN38.3 pass, purchasing and subsequent pilot production moved to the alternative can after existing stock was consumed.
title: Alternative Can Supplier Pilot Transition

contents: Manual shaping before pre-welding varied by operator and repeatedly created uncoated-edge damage and short-circuit risk. I separated the positive- and negative-electrode damage mechanisms, built a temporary jig, defined shape, position, and acceptance criteria, and ran sample and teardown tests. The condition was verified with about 400 samples, used in subsequent pilot production, and reflected in process/inspection standards, the P-FMEA, and production-equipment RFQ.
summary: Manual shaping before pre-welding varied by operator and repeatedly created uncoated-edge damage and short-circuit risk. The condition was verified with about 400 samples, used in subsequent pilot production, and reflected in process/inspection standards, the P-FMEA, and production-equipment RFQ.
title: NCM Pre-Forming Process Validation

contents: Process-level MES data existed, but a cell's full history was not connected, so investigating ten customer-requested cells took about three days. After a MES enhancement request was rejected for cost, I spent about three weeks building Power Query consolidation and Excel VBA search and linking logic. A single search took 5–10 seconds and a ten-cell investigation about three minutes; the tool was used on site during my employment and handed over.
summary: Process-level MES data existed, but a cell's full history was not connected, so investigating ten customer-requested cells took about three days. A single search took 5–10 seconds and a ten-cell investigation about three minutes; the tool was used on site during my employment and handed over.
title: A Cell S/N Trace Tool Connecting Fragmented Process Data

contents: Experience-dependent assembly and inspection created variation in work time and missed checks. While performing overhaul and precision assembly, I documented parts, torque, alignment, leak, and repeatability checks in run sheets and SOPs and trained operators. Rework and overtime were observed to decrease, while team monthly output increased from 1–2 to 4–5 units during the same period.
summary: Experience-dependent assembly and inspection created variation in work time and missed checks. Rework and overtime were observed to decrease, while team monthly output increased from 1–2 to 4–5 units during the same period.
title: Vacuum-Robot Overhaul Standardization

contents: Film cracking and particles recurred within warranty life under repeated high-temperature use. A colleague handled recipe and bath analysis; I handled staged sample production and evaluation, inspection criteria, and customer-result feedback. The revised condition entered production and was monitored for about a year through the transition from legacy-condition parts.
summary: Film cracking and particles recurred within warranty life under repeated high-temperature use. The revised condition entered production and was monitored for about a year through the transition from legacy-condition parts.
title: High-Temperature Anodizing Film Development for OLED Parts

contents: Stable internal results were insufficient when customer measurement methods and acceptance criteria differed. I rebuilt surface-treatment and inspection criteria, including Hi-Pot, acid resistance, and corrosion resistance, and supported same-sample correlation and technical audits. Same-sample measurement correlation was established, and the technical qualification conditions were added to QCPs, run sheets, and inspection standards.
summary: Stable internal results were insufficient when customer measurement methods and acceptance criteria differed. Same-sample measurement correlation was established, and the technical qualification conditions were added to QCPs, run sheets, and inspection standards.
title: Technical Qualification of CVD and PECVD Components

contents: Lab stripping was possible, but overlapping ultrasonic zones damaged the surface and left roughness, diffusion, and reusability risks unresolved. I documented sample and scale-up results and turned relative product/transducer movement, repeatability, and stopping criteria into pre-fabrication checks. Normal operation was not achieved; the case established that stripping feasibility and product reusability must be judged separately.
summary: Lab stripping was possible, but overlapping ultrasonic zones damaged the surface and left roughness, diffusion, and reusability risks unresolved. Normal operation was not achieved; the case established that stripping feasibility and product reusability must be judged separately.
title: Diffuser Ultrasonic Stripping Scale-up Failure Analysis

contents: A model that performed well on public data still had to be checked against field images with different lighting, angles, and surfaces. I handled model training, evaluation, and reporting, separating public data from about 198 field images and comparing misses and false detections across augmentation, model combinations, and thresholds. The limited field evaluation exposed the distribution gap and produced an evaluation process that prioritizes missed defects when comparing models and thresholds.
summary: A model that performed well on public data still had to be checked against field images with different lighting, angles, and surfaces. The limited field evaluation exposed the distribution gap and produced an evaluation process that prioritizes missed defects when comparing models and thresholds.
title: Building an AI Model to Find Defects in Welding Images

contents: Meeting a target output required checking cycle time, equipment count, and layout before adding equipment. In a ten-person team, I handled communication setup, technical research for throughput and layout calculations, and AI-candidate review; ladder and SCADA implementation remain team contributions. The team connected Factory I/O, PLC, SCADA, and OPC UA with a virtual expansion scenario sized to a target output.

title: Factory I/O Virtual Factory Expansion Scenario

contents: JSON references had to survive exchanges between the PC and teaching pendant, while the robot command and status-monitoring paths needed one coherent flow. I defined the system goal and integration sequence, then implemented Conty JSON compatibility, four PC-HMI pages, the Python Robot Controller, MQTT/DB, and a read-only Web Twin connection. The Digital Twin implementation centralizes the IndyDCP command path in the Robot Controller and separates Robot A/B/C status into read-only display and history-storage paths.
summary: JSON references had to survive exchanges between the PC and teaching pendant, while the robot command and status-monitoring paths needed one coherent flow. title: Indy7 Robot Digital Twin Implementation Project

contents: Manufacturing, semiconductor, and battery knowledge accumulated with inconsistent terms and links, making evidence retrieval difficult. I structured the Markdown/YAML vault and link-graph index, then built a CLI that synchronizes changed files to ChromaDB and retrieves/reranks candidates. The current public main includes the knowledge vault, link-graph index, and sync/query flow.

contents: Running example code once is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained and reproduced. I organized learning topics around preprocessing, training, evaluation, and reproducibility, documenting checks needed before manufacturing-data use. The current public main is a README-based archive of learning topics and experiment criteria.
summary: Running example code once is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained and reproduced. The current public main is a README-based archive of learning topics and experiment criteria.

contents: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. I linked question, theory, source, rights, and publication state and designed learner flow and regression checks that prevent pre-submission answer leakage. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.
summary: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.

contents: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. I classified 165 de-identified questions into eight types and generated official-source links, guides, search pages, and structured data from one source. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.
summary: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.
title: Guidebook for Common Unemployment Benefit Questions

contents: An AI reading data and proposing an action does not prove authority to execute or a safe external result. I am organizing Ontology/LLM Wiki knowledge and execution conditions into an agent specification and designing the order of evidence review, human approval, and stop conditions. The current local-foundation stage studies how decisions vary across LLMs and data and where human approval must remain.
summary: An AI reading data and proposing an action does not prove authority to execute or a safe external result. The current local-foundation stage studies how decisions vary across LLMs and data and where human approval must remain.
